map.由三因子求净资产收益率 使用指南: Return on Equity from Three Factors User Guide
map.杜邦分析 ROE 计算器，输入净利率、资产周转率与权益乘数，按 ROE=净利率×: The DuPont ROE Calculator takes the net margin, asset turnover and equity multiplier and decomposes the return on equity as ROE = net margin × turnover × equity multiplier, exposing the driving factors.
map.ROE = 净利率 × 资产周转率 × 权益乘数: ROE = net margin × asset turnover × equity multiplier
map.输入净利率、资产周转率与权益乘数，求 ROE。: Enter the net margin, asset turnover and equity multiplier to get ROE.
map.用杜邦分析把 ROE 拆成净利率、资产周转、权益乘数，定位驱动因子。: Use the DuPont analysis to break ROE into net margin, asset turnover and equity multiplier and locate the driving factor.
map.ROE 下滑时，判断是盈利、效率还是杠杆出了问题。: When ROE falls, work out whether profitability, efficiency or leverage is the problem.
map.管理层对标标杆企业，针对性改善最弱的因子。: Benchmark the management against leading companies and improve the weakest factor specifically.
map.：某公司净利率 15%、资产周转率 1.2 次、权益乘数 2.0，则 ROE=1: A company with a net margin of 15%, asset turnover of 1.2 and an equity multiplier of 2.0 has ROE=15%×1.2×2.0=36%, so the high return comes from the combination of profitability, efficiency and leverage.
map.杜邦分析的三个因子分别反映什么？: What does each of the three DuPont factors represent?
map.净利率反映盈利能力，资产周转率反映运营效率，权益乘数反映财务杠杆；ROE=三者的: Net margin reflects profitability, asset turnover reflects operating efficiency and the equity multiplier reflects financial leverage. ROE is the product of the three, which makes step-by-step attribution easy.
map.权益乘数怎么算？: How is the equity multiplier computed?
map.权益乘数=总资产÷净资产=1÷(1−资产负债率)，杠杆越高乘数越大，对 ROE: Equity multiplier = total assets ÷ net assets = 1÷(1 − debt ratio). The higher the leverage the larger the multiplier, the more clearly it amplifies ROE, and the more it amplifies risk.
